exclusions: Every lead and candidate in prior immutable requests through 2026-08-14 was excluded, including the parked RÖM — Whispering Dub revisit.
All 26 ledger identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material, protected Deep Under → Wurk opening handoff, protected ending, and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.

Autokinetic — Telepathic was excluded despite a verified 133 BPM identity because its only clean current paths would interfere with the protected opening or ending rather than reveal a lawful new middle-journey function.

Internal Observer, Third Person, Enigma Trax, and several small-label releases were excluded where only collection-level language existed, exact-track behaviour or BPM remained unsupported, or the evidence could not distinguish one track from its release siblings.

Advanced Human, Oscar Sanchez, Disguised, Pyramidal Decode, Henry Greenleaf, TSVI, and similar material was excluded where available descriptions foregrounded relentless motion, peak-time impact, volatility, confrontation, explosive release, or high-intensity pressure.

No lead was admitted for novelty, release date, popularity, duration, BPM, key, artist reputation, label reputation, or quota completion.
